name: Grocery Wizard
install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi; export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"; uv sync --all-extras; uv run streamlit skills --yes; mkdir -p .cursor/skills .agents/skills; ln -sfn "$(readlink .agents/skills/developing-with-streamlit)" .cursor/skills/developing-with-streamlit 2>/dev/null || true; ln -sfn "$(pwd)/.agents/skills/tidy-first" .cursor/skills/tidy-first 2>/dev/null || true'
